allow: Bash(ssh -o ConnectTimeout=8 -o BatchMode=yes root@organelle.local 'echo "--- deployed patch folder ---"; ls -la "/sdcard/Patches/!/Cut It" 2>/dev/null || echo "\(patch folder not found\)"; echo "--- pd processes ---"; ps ax | grep "[p]d " | head -3')

Bash(ssh -o ConnectTimeout=8 root@organelle.local 'echo "=== how hard is the patch working? ==="; ps -o pid,etime,time,pcpu,comm -p 494 2>/dev/null || ps ax -o pid,etime,time,pcpu,comm | grep " 494 "; echo; echo "=== load average ==="; cat /proc/loadavg; echo; echo "=== is the patch talking to the display? \(OSC to mother, port 4001\) ==="; cat /proc/net/udp | awk "NR==1 || /:0FA1|:0FA2|:0FA3/ {print}" | head -5')

Bash(ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@organelle.local 'echo "=== UDP packets out, sampled 4s apart ==="; a=$\(cat /proc/net/snmp | awk "/^Udp:/ && NR%2==0 {print \\$5}"\); sleep 4; b=$\(cat /proc/net/snmp | awk "/^Udp:/ && NR%2==0 {print \\$5}"\); echo "  delta over 4s: $\(\(b-a\)\) datagrams  =  $\(\( \(b-a\)/4 \)\) per second"; echo; echo "=== framebuffer? ==="; ls -l /dev/fb* 2>/dev/null || echo "  no /dev/fb* -- the OLED is driven by the mother binary, not a Linux fb"')

Bash(ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@organelle.local 'for n in 0 1; do echo "=== fb$n ==="; echo -n "  name: "; cat /sys/class/graphics/fb$n/name 2>/dev/null || echo "?"; echo -n "  size: "; cat /sys/class/graphics/fb$n/virtual_size 2>/dev/null || echo "?"; echo -n "  bpp:  "; cat /sys/class/graphics/fb$n/bits_per_pixel 2>/dev/null || echo "?"; echo -n "  stride: "; cat /sys/class/graphics/fb$n/stride 2>/dev/null || echo "?"; done')

Bash(ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@organelle.local 'echo "=== what the RUNNING pd actually loaded \(/tmp/patch\) ==="; cd /tmp/patch 2>/dev/null && for f in main.pd u_root.pd g_oled.pd u_err.pd u_init.pd; do printf "%-14s %s\\n" "$f" "$\(md5sum $f 2>/dev/null | cut -d" " -f1\)"; done; echo; echo "=== when was /tmp/patch populated vs pd started ==="; stat -c "%y  %n" /tmp/patch/g_oled.pd 2>/dev/null; ps -o lstart= -p 494 2>/dev/null')

Bash(ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@organelle.local 'echo "=== /tmp/patch ==="; ls -ld /tmp/patch; readlink -f /tmp/patch; echo; echo "=== contents ==="; ls /tmp/patch/ 2>&1 | head; echo; echo "=== checksums of what is RUNNING ==="; for f in main.pd u_root.pd g_oled.pd u_err.pd u_init.pd; do printf "%-14s %s\\n" "$f" "$\(md5sum /tmp/patch/$f 2>&1 | cut -d" " -f1\)"; done')
